note: Stored routing policy for the WireGuard tunnels on this host. This file is
the DESIRED state; `wg-policy apply` reconciles the live iptables/sysctl
state to match it, and `wg-policy check` reports drift without changing
Why this exists: the forwarding and NAT rules are VOLATILE. podman, libvirt
and docker rebuild their chains on restart, and anything that flushes the
filter or nat table silently strips these rules. Boot-time persistence
(wg-lan-nat.service and its drop-ins) only covers a reboot, so a client that
connects after a container-engine restart finds a tunnel that comes up
cleanly and routes nothing. wg-policy-watch reconciles on every new client
Every rule deployed from this file carries the iptables comment
'cockpit-wg:<dest-id>', which is both how drift is detected and the only
thing this tool will ever delete.

gateway.note: Internet traffic from every tunnel must leave via this gateway.

tunnels.note: extra_source_cidrs are networks reached THROUGH a peer (the ELT static range); they need the same egress NAT as the tunnel subnet itself.

destinations.note: The physical LAN. NAT is required: a LAN host replying to a 172.16.x source has no route back, since the router only knows 192.168.2.0/24.
The wg-easy container's macvlan address, reached over a dedicated shim rather than bridge0.
libvirt network. LIBVIRT_FWI REJECTs anything egressing virbr-edy that is not already RELATED,ESTABLISHED, so the FORWARD rules MUST be inserted at the top of the chain, never appended.
The default libvirt network. Same LIBVIRT_FWI REJECT applies as for edy-lab. This destination was missing entirely: the host could reach 192.168.122.x while every tunnel client could not.

No NAT needed: the host IS these containers' gateway and already routes 172.16.0.0/24 back down wg0, so replies find their way home unmasqueraded. The FORWARD rules are still declared so the path does not depend on the chain policy staying ACCEPT.
The reverse-proxy pod network (edy-rproxy-*). Same reasoning as podman0.
The edy-dev pod network. Same reasoning as podman0.
Default route: everything not matched above egresses bridge0 to the gateway and is masqueraded onto the LAN address.
